Messages.Author: Jeroen Rombouts
Messages.Body:
Hi,

Last week we were talking about Wind Dance. Sombody suggested that it may
be possible to cancel the additional strike from superior Wind Dance with
primal instinct and then play a new strike. Is that possible? Why (not)?

Primal Instinct
[aus] Strike: dodge.
[AUS] Only usable by the acting vampire after the opposing minion has chosen
his or her strike. Cancel this acting vampire's strike and choose a new one.

Wind Dance
[tha]: Strike: dodge.
[THA] Strike : dodge with an additional strike: dodge.

follow up question (AKA the question I really wanted to ask but
forgot):

Is the aditional strike from Wind Dance a part of the strike? PI
doesn't say "cancel the acting minion's strike CARD", it only cancels
the strike. So if you cancel the first dodge, what happens to the the
additional strike: dodge? Or is this "additional strike:dodge" an
inseperable part of the strike: "dodge with an additional strike:
dodge"

Jeroen

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
salem wrote:
> which is curious, as i would have thought you would be able to cancel
> your additional wind dance dodge, but then be forced to choose it
> again as your new strike.
> Kind of like maneuvering with a gun, and then cancelling your
> compulsory gun strike with Primal Instincts leaves you still having to
> choose your gun as your new strike.

Maneuvering with a strike is covered under the rules and the rules are
followed. The rules place no restrictions on Wind Dance's effect.

> What happens if you strike superior Wind Dance and then cancel your
> initial strike with PI. Do you still get the additional Strike:Dodge?

No.
